issues.description: The Rust 1.82 port marks two failing project-local bodies as `external_body`, making their contracts trusted assumptions even though the verifier cannot prove either implementation.
issues.rationale: Both functions are project-local derived logic rather than intentional FFI/hardware boundaries. `PageTableMode::covers` exposes a public `when_used_as_spec` contract, while `lemma_recursive_visit_induction` is a broadcast proof available through `group_ghost_tree`. The PR body says both failures are temporarily skipped. Under fixed Verus 9b8b5567ffffadd8223ffec889a86f2a5424b038, removing only the relevant `external_body` makes `covers` fail its line-34 postcondition and the ghost lemma fail its line-977 postcondition, confirming that the annotations expand the trusted boundary. Official descendant 6772140e630958cdf11c69b063fdd9efad49e8c6 later removes the ghost annotation while retaining a checked proof (`230 verified, 0 errors` under its fixed toolchain). No checked `covers` repair was found; a134cdfe1b8724b437d49c6a74518834c5de25a3 resolves that boundary by deleting the entire crate, not by proving the body.
issues.source_evidence:
after/aster_common/src/page_table/page_table_mode.rs
33:     #[verifier::external_body]
34:     fn covers(r: &Range<Vaddr>) -> (res: bool)
35:         ensures res == Self::covers_spec(r)

after/vstd_extra/src/ghost_tree.rs
969:     #[verifier::external_body]
970:     pub broadcast proof fn lemma_recursive_visit_induction(self, path: TreePath<N>)
977:         ensures
978:             #[trigger] self.recursive_visit(path) == ...

Controlled fixed-toolchain runs that remove only one annotation report one postcondition failure at page_table_mode.rs:34 and ghost_tree.rs:977 respectively. The exported snapshot remains the immutable official problem commit; the diagnostic copies are not benchmark inputs.
issues.verification: At the immutable problem snapshot, Verus 9b8b5567ffffadd8223ffec889a86f2a5424b038, Rust 1.82.0, and Z3 4.12.5 report 178/0 for vstd_extra and 214/0 for aster_common with the trusted boundaries. Separate diagnostic copies removing only one annotation reproduce 178 verified, 1 postcondition error at ghost_tree.rs:977 and 214 verified, 1 postcondition error at page_table_mode.rs:34. Official ghost repair 6772140e was verified as 230/0 with Verus 0b6f3cbb, Rust 1.88.0, and Z3 4.12.5.
